X-rays include:
• Up to 2 periapical dental x-rays every year.
• Up to 2 bitewing dental x-rays every year.
• Up to 1 complete series of full-mouth or panoramic x-rays every 3 years.

1 Scaling/root planing per each quadrant every year.
1 Full mouth debridement every 24 consecutive months.
2 periodontal maintenance every year.
